verdict.rationale: monday.com documents native agents that users can create by describing a workflow, then assign items to, message in updates, or @mention to start work, with replies, statuses, and follow-ups included. That is direct in-product task delegation to an AI assistant. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Talk to agents like teammates. Message them in updates, assign them items, and @mention them in any conversation to kick off real work — replies, statuses, and follow-ups included.
Describe any workflow in your own words to create a unique agent in minutes.
Build agents for your exact needs. Define the goal, set the rules, watch the results.
